heroHeadline: Jailed Ex-PM Garibashvili Hit With New 11-15 Year Bribery Charge Days After Breaking With Ivanishvili
heroSubtitle: Prosecutors charged imprisoned former PM Irakli Garibashvili with a new Defense Ministry bribery count carrying 11-15 years, days after his public break with Georgian Dream founder Bidzina Ivanishvili; eight Ivanishvili-linked companies were meanwhile transferred from a Luxembourg entity into his wife's name amid analyst warnings of a possible UK sanctions push, Tbilisi protesters marked Ukraine's Independence Day with a solidarity march on the movement's 635th consecutive day, and occupied Tskhinvali registered four candidates for a September 18 'presidential' vote Georgia does not recognize.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
